blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) on Wednesday said the Philippines wants to join a global financing program for national forest restoration. In a statement, Environment Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh “highlighted the country’s readiness” to join the Tropical Forests Forever Facility (TFFF) Fast Track Program. She brought up this matter while speaking during a session at the New York Climate Week. The TFFF “seeks to assist frontrunner tropical forest countries in accessing long-term, results-based financing,” the DENR explained. It also aims to address the gap in the amount of annual forest investments globally. READ: DENR 2040 target: Cut plastic waste […]...
